selection: First6 by fixed target-name hash from metadata-qualified14; before donor scores.
condition: Only if fixed primary fails donor seed0 guards.
fit_test: Disjoint halves of frozen seed0 actual400. Same independent NTC reference. No oracle output can be used in a submission or training.
constraints: Use original V29 projector: exact gene sums and row libraries. Fitted-shape-at-predicted-means has exactly baseline profiles; old-shape-at-fitted-means has exactly real-fit profiles. Cell-mean CPM<=.0005 is audited and failure retained, not silently dropped.
limitations: Six reused donor target groups,200 fitting/200 scoring cells, not full400-cell power. Mean comparisons also change row-depth margins (NTC versus treated); within-mean shape comparisons match original row/gene margins exactly, but projection alters shape. Oracle means are noisy sample estimates; real-fit is only a split-half replicate. No causal attribution to one mechanism, independence between technical seeds, or hidden-score forecast.
